description: We are a creative and motivated team about technology innovation and problem solving
summary: MERSAD is an intelligent agricultural protection platform that aims to prevent crop losses by predicting environmental risks before they occur. It combines NASA satellite data, weather information, IoT sensors, AI, and Digital Twin technology to monitor multiple agricultural threats, including heat stress, soil moisture imbalance, and salinity. Its key innovation is integrating early risk prediction with Smart Shield, a farmer-controlled system designed to recommend and automate preventive actions, shifting agriculture from reactive damage control to proactive protection.
details:
MERSAD is an AI-powered agricultural protection platform that predicts risks such as heat stress, soil moisture imbalance, and salinity using NASA data, weather information, and IoT sensors. It alerts farmers and recommends preventive actions, with Smart Shield designed to automate protection.

Our goal is to reduce crop losses, improve water management, and support sustainable agriculture, targeting up to 70% less preventable crop loss.

Technologies used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Lovable, Google Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude NASA Open APIs, Python Analytics, MQTT Protocols.

Innovation: MERSAD combines AI prediction, satellite data, Digital Twin technology, and automated farm protection in one platform, designed with Saudi Arabia’s climate and farmers’ needs in mind.
